'''Gainor Furlan''' is the [[innkeeper]] of [[Wayland's Forge]] in [[Remen]], a town in northern [[Altara]].{{Ref|{{twotc}}, Gainor Furlan}}

==Appearance==
Master Furlan is a plump, bald man with brown eyes and a smooth, pink face.{{ref/book|3|33}}

==Activities==
Master Furlan greets [[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Lan Mandragoran]], [[Perrin Aybara]], and [[Loial]] to his inn when the quartet are traveling to [[Tear]]. He tells the group of the [[Hunters of the Horn]] that are staying at his inn.{{ref/book|3|33}}
